title: Documentary
when: True stories, reportage, research with a human side, case studies: observed rather than presented

voice.style: warm, close and plainspoken, like someone who was there

rules: Cold open: start mid-scene on a detail (a close-up, one sound, one word), pull out to the context, and bring the title in late.
Headings only as lower thirds (heading: bottom); names and places as captions in the picture.
Handheld on observed moments; lock the camera (camera: none, lens.handheld 0 on the beat) for data, so numbers read as fact.
Real imagery wherever possible: plates graded into the palette (plate.treatment tint or duotone).
Let the subject's own words carry the key line: a quote or a kinetic stack, not a paraphrase.
